text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x) ::: Pets are allowed in building x.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in building x.
EqualDeposit(y) ::: The security deposit is equal to y.
MoreDeposit(y) ::: The security deposit is more than y.
Owns(x, y) ::: x owns y.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: Building x is managed.
Rent(x, y) ::: The monthly rent at building x is y.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: x moves in with y.
WillRent(x) ::: x will rent an apartment.
Premises:
∃x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (DepositRequired(x) → ∃y (EqualDeposit(y) ∨ MoreDeposit(y))) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ∧ Pet(fluffy) ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat. Cats are pets.
Pet(cat) ::: Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ∧ Rent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building. The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
WillRent(tom) ↔ (MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ∧ ¬MoreDeposit(1500)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
MoreDeposit(2000) ∧ MoreDeposit(1500) ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
WillRent(oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
